text:
Maya: Quick thread — pulled ~30 items from last week's onboarding wave. High-level asks we keep seeing: 1) per-route billing visibility (finance wants per-feature cost), 2) clearer credential error UX during onboarding, 3) default timeout too short for long exports/summaries, 4) sample prompt templates / examples for common flows. These are surfacing in renewal conversations so would like to triage and label. Anyone available to help categorize and propose priorities?

Elliot: Thanks Maya. Can you paste a few raw quotes or examples? I can map them to product areas. Also do we have churn or NPS signals tied to these accounts?

Maya: Pasting 3 representative quotes + spreadsheet link: https://redwood.app/sheets/onboard-feedback-195432
- Greenbridge: "we can't see cost per endpoint — finance won't sign off"
- Nimbus Health: "we're getting auth errors during service principal setup, docs didn't match"
- ParkCo: "timeouts kill our long export jobs, we keep retrying"

Rowan: Confirmed — Greenbridge and ParkCo mentioned this in their renewal calls. Greenbridge said they're unlikely to renew without clearer cost breakdowns; ParkCo wants an interim workaround asap.

Liu: On onboarding side I've flagged 7 accounts in 'stuck' for the last 2 weeks. Common root: credential naming mismatch + unclear service principal step in docs. I can update the checklist but need PM wording for the public docs (what to call the field, example values).

Elliot: Proposal for quick triage: P0 = renewal blocker (Greenbridge), P1 = high usability regression (credential UX), P2 = nice-to-have (prompt templates). Does that align?

Maya: I agree. I'll add tags to the spreadsheet: priority / area / account / suggested owner. Quick dev ask idea: surface a "billing breakdown" toggle in route settings + expand credential errors with a short FAQ link. Quick copy suggestion: "Credential error: check service principal name and role bindings — see steps -> link."

feedback-bot: Created ticket PROD-4321 "per-route billing visibility" and linked it to this thread.

Sam (eng-runtime): Looping eng in — short-term we can add a CSV export of per-route usage (fast) in 2 sprints; dashboard work is longer runway. We can also add more verbose error codes for auth failures in the next sprint.

Elliot: Perfect. I'll add PROD-4321 to the roadmap and mark Greenbridge canary. Maya — can you set a sync with Greenbridge this week and share the interim CSV when ready?

Maya: :thumbsup: Will schedule. I'll also add a note in the renewal playbook and ping CS for any other accounts with same asks.

Sam: If anyone wants a quick demo of the CSV export format, I can spin one up later today.

Maya: Thanks all — tagging follow-ups in the sheet.
